name: •Adrenal Surge
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: •Endorphin Dump
description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

name: •Dopamine Boost
description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Impervious Flesh
description: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

name: Critical Decapitation
description: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Shadow Bind
description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Reload [1]
description: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Man Catcher
description: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model’s melee range for one round.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Druid's Wrath
description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on arcane attack rolls targeting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster. Druid’s Wrath lasts for one turn.

name: Hyper-Regeneration
description: Remove d3 damage points from this model at the start of each of its activations.

name: Sacred Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Critical Thunderclap
description: On a critical hit, models hit without Resistance: Electricity become knocked down.

name: Earth Shaker
description: When this model hits an enemy model with this attack, the model hit and models within 2" of it become knocked down.

name: Bradigus Thorle the Runecarver
featDescription: Choose a table edge and a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly toward the chosen table edge in the order you choose. At the end of your turn, choose a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly away from the chosen table edge in the order you choose.

name: Mystic Wards
description: Enemy animi and enemy upkeep spells on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are in its control range immediately expire. Enemy arcane attacks targeting a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup suffer –5 RNG. Mystic Wards lasts for one round.

name: Rift
description: Center a 3" template on the model directly hit. The template is rough terrain and remains in play for one round.

name: Rock Wall
description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Synergy
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: Earth Magic
description: When a construct warbeast in this model’s battlegroup is forced to use its animus while in this model’s control range, reduce the COST of the animus by 1.

name: Repair [d3+3] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Stonebinder
description: Only construct warbeasts can be part of this model’s battlegroup. This model cannot take control of wild living warbeasts.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Critical Smite
description: On a critical hit, the model hit can be slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model, it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

name: Blackclad
description: This model is a Blackclad model.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Concentrated Fire (★ Action)
description: This activation, models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

name: •Zephyr (★ Action)
description: Each model in this unit can immediately advance up to 3".

name: Self-Sacrifice
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in this unit within 3" of this model to be destroyed and this model removes 1 damage point.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Chain Lightning (★ Attack)
description: Chain Lightning is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Chain Lightning damage rolls are simultaneous.

name: •Obscuring Mist (★ Action)
description: Models in this unit gain concealment for one round.

name: •Stone Spray (★Attack)
description: Stone Spray is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Prowl
description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

name: Battle Wizard
description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: Reposition [3"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

name: Brutal Charge
description: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Gang Fighter
description: When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.

name: Sic ’Em
description: Once per turn if this model is not engaged, when a friendly model hits an enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can charge the model hit. This model’s charge attack roll is boosted.

name: Tracker
description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS when declaring a charge.

name: Hunter
description: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

name: Leadership [Reeves of Orboros]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Reeves of Orboros models gain Hunter.

name: Sniper
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Sprint
description: At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, this model can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Powerful Charge
description: This model gains +2 to charge attack rolls with this weapon.

name: Battle Wizard
description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Phase Jump (★ Action)
description: If it is within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model, place this model anywhere completely within 12" of its current location. Otherwise, place it completely within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model anywhere on the table. After using Phase Jump, this model’s activation ends.

name: •Hunter’s Mark (★Attack)
description:
Hunter’s Mark is a RNG 10 arcane attack that causes no damage.
Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

name: •Stone Spray (★Attack)
description: Stone Spray is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Prowl
description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

name: Fleeting Storm
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. Ranged attacks targetting a model completely within the template suffer –3 RNG. The AOE remains in play for one round.

name: Lightning Tendrils
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Resistance: Electricity. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap.

name: Bleed Power
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, it gains 1 fury point for each friendly Faction construct Cohort model it is control range. This model cannot exceed its ARC in fury points as a result of Bleed Power.

name: Lesser Warlock
description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Irresistible Force
description: The spellcaster gains Bulldoze. Irresistible Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Ram
description: When an enemy model is hit by this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, it becomes knocked down and can be pushed 1" directly away from this model. If the model hit is pushed, this model can immediately advance 1" directly toward it.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Indomitable
description: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. Indomitable lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Dig In (★Action)
description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

name: Fertilizer
description: When a living or undead model is boxed by an attack made with this weapon, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is forest terrain that remains in play for one round.

name: Fertilizer
description: When a living or undead model is boxed by an attack made with this weapon, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is forest terrain that remains in play for one round.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Spontaneous Combustion
description: The spellcaster and models within 2" of it immediately suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Fire’s Fury
description: This model gains +5 ARM against fire damage. While suffering the Fire continuous effect, this model cannot become knocked down and gains boosted attack and damage rolls.

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Arcane Suppression
description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Arcane Suppression lasts for one round.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Witch Hunter
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, this model can immediately make a basic attack targeting the enemy spellcaster. If the spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: Purgation
description: Gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls with this weapon against models with an enemy upkeep spell or animus on them.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Earth’s Blessing
description: The spellcaster cannot be pushed, knocked down, made stationary, or moved by a slam. Earth’s Blessing lasts for one round.

name: Follow Up
description: When this model slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.

name: Slammer
description: This model can make slam power attacks without being forced. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Wraithbane
description: Target friendly Faction model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Wraithbane lasts for one turn.

name: Controlled Warping
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following warp effects. Warp effects last for one round. If this model frenzies it must choose Warp Strength at the start of its activation.

name: •Ghostly
description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

name: •Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: •Warp Strength
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: Regeneration [d3]
description: This model can be forced to remove d3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Ornery
description: The spellcaster gains Retaliatory Strike. Ornery lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Fight-or-Flight Instinct
description: This model can run or charge without being forced.

name: Chain Attack: Grab & Smash
description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately make a head-butt or throw power attack against that model even if it charged that activation.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Elusive
description: The spellcaster gains Dodge. Elusive lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: Vault
description: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can be forced to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Reeve of Orboros Chieftain & Standard

name: Command Attachment [Reeve of Orboros]
description: This command attachment can be added to a Reeve of Orboros unit.

name: Go to Ground
description: This model can use Go to Ground once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. For one round, models in this unit gain cover and Resistance: Blast and do not block LOS.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Granted: Rise
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit that are knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase stand up.

name: Take Up
description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

name: Immobile
description: This model has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

name: Shifting Powers
description: Choose one of the following effects at the start of this unit’s activation:

name: •Healing Field
description: Remove d3 damage points from the models in this unit and from other friendly Faction models within 2" of one or more models in this unit. Roll separately for each model.

name: •Shifting
description: Place one model in this unit anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. Then place the other models in this unit 2" of it.

name: •Teleportation
description: If all three Shifting Stone models in this unit are in play, place one friendly Faction model whose base is within the triangular area between them anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. The placed model must forfeit its Normal Movement after being placed this turn. A model can be placed only once per turn as a result of Teleportation.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Quagmire
description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

name: Batten Down the Hatches
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

name: Torment
description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

name: Lesser Warlock
description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Limited Battlegroup [War Boar MMD47]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is War Boar MMD47.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Critical Pitch
description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Companion [Carver Ultimus]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Carver Ultimus. If Carver is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Carver’s battlegroup.

name: Recoil
description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Full Boar
description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Exhaust Fumes
description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Forced Reload [1]
description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Obstacle

description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Rough Terrain
description: This terrain feature is rough terrain.

name: Spike Trap
description: A Spike Trap's dimensions are 50mm square area terrain.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.
